title: Pass application name through the capture interface
description: Remove the need for "application flavor" in the capture interface by adding an "application name" parameter that can be passed through (to dumpcap)

commits_data.title: Pass application name through the capture interface
commits_data.message:
Pass application name through the capture interface

Remove the need for "application flavor" in the capture interface by adding an "application name" parameter that can be passed through (to dumpcap)
